figurative_meaning_bn: অত্যন্ত স্পষ্ট, খাঁটি, টাটকা, তরতাজা, নির্ভেজাল, বিশুদ্ধ ইত্যাদি
figurative_meaning_en: Extremely clear, pure, fresh, brand new, unadulterated, genuine, etc.
example_sentences_in_english: The fish in the market are fresh as can be.
note: The idiom draws from the vivid imagery of fish thriving in water, common in Bengali rural life.
